description: Recorded healthy bootstrap Simu5G/OMNeT++ scalar run plus matching vector index and generated INI retained as a minimal parser and replay fixture.
known_limitations: The fixture is a recorded artifact and does not prove that Simu5G, INET, OMNeT++, Docker, or service startup works on the current machine.
No matching .vec payload is retained because no tracked .vec file existed for this run in the repository.
The fixture represents one bootstrap/healthy configuration only; degraded fault behavior remains a later validation concern.
provenance_notes: The .sca and .vci files contain run General-0-20260728-02:59:43-9667 and point to the generated phase_bootstrap_normal.ini path.
The generated INI configures 12 UEs, 60 seconds of simulated time, and output-scalar-file/output-vector-file names for phase_bootstrap_normal.
Checksums were computed from the copied files during Batch 2 before runtime directories were cleaned.
